bible.title: The Pact-Chest at Fallow Hollow
bible.kernel: A former paymaster hires mercenaries to recover a stolen chest. The forest keeper will not hand it over.

cast.name: Jeelus-Tei
cast.who: former garrison paymaster who now pleads for a last clean account
cast.want: to recover the garrison's payroll chest

cast.name: Ilindhar
cast.who: an elf entertainer who lives alone in the old-growth and answers to no market
cast.want: to keep the pact-chest and its promise

cast.name: Thelma
cast.who: raider captain who took to guarding what she prizes
cast.want: to keep the chest and the raiders' claim it carries

bible.situation: Jeelus-Tei says raiders stole the garrison payroll and names a clearing in the Western Forests where they camp. He hires the company to fetch the chest. The forests hold a known solitary elf, but the client knows nothing more.
bible.goal: to retrieve the garrison's payroll chest and return it to the client
arc: Scout the raider camp at Fallow Hollow the client named and confirm who holds the chest → yields: a carved wooden whistle stamped with a Greenmantle mark

Use the whistle as a call to find Ilindhar in his grove and press him for what the raiders took → yields: a sealed iron chest beneath his hearth that bears the garrison's signed pledge-will and Ilindhar's sworn oath to keep it

Bring the sealed pledge-chest back to Fallow Hollow to hand it over for the client and face the raider captain who claims it → yields: the pledge-chest delivered into Jeelus-Tei's hands after Thelma was beaten and her claim driven off
bible.twist: the chest is not payroll coin; it contains the garrison's signed pledge-will that grants command and lands to its holder, and Ilindhar is the chest's sworn keeper
tensions: the client's own sale of the garrison makes him compromised and desperate
Ilindhar's oath and lonely stewardship will not yield the chest without cost
Thelma and her raiders hold force at the named clearing and will fight to keep the claim
openDirections: offer Ilindhar a substitute pledge: a new oath or a companion to break his solitude and win the chest willingly
word spreads that other bands learn the pledge-will's power and move to seize it whether the company succeeds or fails

shipped.title: Scout Fallow Hollow
shipped.situation: Jeelus-Tei sits with a folded payroll and pleads for one last clean account. He says the garrison chest left the fort and vanished into the Western Forests. Scouts report a fresh raider camp at Fallow Hollow with new smoke and tracks. The pay is fixed, and what else the job shakes loose the company keeps. The matter smells of a payout worth a string of small jobs.
shipped.job: Scout the raider camp at Fallow Hollow and confirm who holds the payroll chest
